Deep below the ocean waves lies a fortune long forgotten. The temple of Thalasso housed many of people we would now call ancient. They had their lifestyle, their rituals.. ones which are now deemed unnatural.

> Moon Info

CONDITIONS: Ocean, diverse oceanic flora, high pressure.

> Weather

Thalasso can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Forsaken, or Hurricane weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Thalasso's Temple Traps

The path directly behind the ship leads to an intersection. The left path has moving walls in a pattern that push the player off onto the platform or the death pit below, with the pillars between the walls acting as safe zones. The right pathway has spiked walls that slam into the wall periodically and crush the player, with spaces in-between the walls acting as safe zones. A water tunnel is at the end of this path. Both paths lead to the main entrance.

Drowning Chamber

Going to the path to left of the front of the ship, turning left, and continuing straight leads to the "drowning chamber" mentioned by the mysterious voice on Lecaro, which is also where a fire exit is. This chamber begins to fill with water when a player is at the bottom of it, and drowning can be avoided by either jumping on the pillars to escape or going into the fire exit.

Crushers

Going to the path to the right of the front of the ship leads to an intersection. Continuing straight leads to a small entrance that leads to three crushers and another fire exit. There is a safe spot to stand in-between each crusher. From the fire exit door, it is possible to run straight through all three crushers without stopping with the full effects of the TZP-inhalant at 16lbs or less.

Heart Chamber

The path to the left at the intersection leads to a partially submerged chamber. A "Beholder's eye" can be placed on a pedestal to open the heart door in front of the pedestal. This leads to a hidden chamber with seven "Human heart" scrap on pedestals inside. On average, all seven hearts are a little over triple the value of one "Beholder's eye". Jumping prevents drowning and jumping onto objects can help recover stamina.

Water Level

Thalasso's water level will begin to decrease at around 12:30PM and begin to rise again at around 07:30PM. This temporarily creates a new path that can be found by going to the path that is to the front left of the ship, turning left, and turning right instead of continuing straight. This leads to another fire exit previously only accessible with a cruiser (not recommended) or jetpack. This also temporarily gets rid of the water in the aforementioned chamber.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Interacting with the map found on the exterior of Lecaro.

Unlocks

Utril: Go to the path to the left of the front of the ship, turn left, and continue straight. This leads to the "drowning chamber" mentioned by the mysterious voice on Lecaro, which is also where one of the fire exits is. This chamber begins to fill with water when a player is at the bottom of it, and drowning can be avoided by either jumping on the pillars to escape or going into the fire exit. Once it's safe, there will be a hole to crouch into at the bottom of the chamber that leads to an interactable map. Interacting with this map will unlock Utril.

> Lore

Map of Utril

This map is hidden somewhere inside the temple of Thalasso. After interacting with it a strange audio will play. After that Utril will be unlocked for you.

Image & Text ⁠
Past the floating island, through two ravines they light the way, a guide through the darkness of Utril.

Life

Image & Text ⁠
I am nearing my day of birth yet again. It will be the twenty first.
While to most it would seem a day of happiness.\nI look at it the opposite.
This year I have graduated for a course I was happy to start.
But time has shown that it might not be within my interest in this form.
Therefor I feel a part of life was wasted. I have yet to understand what I truly want to do with the years that remain.
I feel like a rock in a river. With life flowing around me. Unmoved. Waiting for change. Change that might never come if I stay this way.

Friends

Image & Text ⁠
During my time in this realm of mortality I have made friends of many. Though very few have stuck with me past my time of being around them.
Grateful I am to those who remain. Those whom I can consider close.
True friends.
However I fear that the friends I have made in the past year become one with those who no longer seek contact with me. The thought haunts me daily. I fear that I might end up alone once more.
I fear the void we call loneliness.
Often I sit down, just me and my thoughts. No one to join my pondering. To fill up the void.

Love

Image & Text ⁠
It was a while ago when I first felt it. I felt it for a friends. But for the three years I was around. I was too scared to say something. And now we talk no longer.
I often wonder what life would be had I been more courageous.
But now I have felt it once more.
Someone else. Another friend.
But it is different this time. While I send it from my side. I know I will never receive it.
While to some it is a blessing. To me it is a curse. I feel the weight on my chest whenever I mention it.
I feel like I am driving them away whenever I send it.
I am lost.
And I do not know the way.

Fate

Image & Text ⁠
My existence, my being, my mortality are comming thougts which cycle through my head more often than not.
My future, my past, my heart's desires. And the choices made which brought me here. Could I have done something different I wonder. Could I have been happy.

I offered to have my heart cut out. In the ceremony of this rotation.
I hope to be placed among the others. I hope to be happy. I hope to be unalone.
I hope for my soul to be at peace within it. And may I be found.
I ask, please, take care of me.
